title: Is the steered behavior persistent across a long conversation, or does it decay?

original_idea.body: With a fixed refusal vector, run multi-turn escalation conversations and measure refusal effectiveness vs turn depth to detect contextual-drift decay; forward passes.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: multi-turn decay of fixed-vector safety targets a leading real-world jailbreak vector (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Fixed vector + multi-turn escalation simulation on one open model; guided (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped with clear success criterion (refusal-vs-turn decay curve) (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public model, forward-pass simulation, externally runnable (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Forward-pass conversation simulation, no training; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Multi-turn steering work exists; fixed-vector decay curve partly open; partially addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Fixed-vector turn-depth decay curve may be partly open.
